meaning: What people do matters more than what they say.
It is better to do something late than not at all.

phrase: Every cloud has a silver lining.
meaning: Even a difficult situation may have a positive side.

phrase:
Where there is a will,
there is a way.
meaning: Determination helps us find a way forward.
कुनै पनि कुराको अति गर्दा हानि हुन्छ।
सहकार्यका लागि दुवै पक्षको सहभागिता आवश्यक हुन्छ।
इच्छा र प्रयास भए सानातिना बाधाले रोक्दैनन्।
दृढ इच्छा भए समाधानको बाटो भेटिन्छ।
